Lewisham | Labour | KPM-1 predicts Labour with a 15.5pp lead. Labour has held a majority since 2010 and has a directly elected mayor since 2002, indicating strong incumbency.
Sunderland | No overall control | KPM-1 predicts Reform UK with a narrow 3.0pp lead over Labour. Labour has held a majority since 1974. Such a tight, fragmented vote makes an outright majority for any party highly unlikely.
Bradford | No overall control | Wikipedia explicitly states "The council has been under No Overall Control since 2026." This direct future-dated information overrides the KPM-1 vote share lead.
Wolverhampton | Labour | KPM-1 predicts Labour with a solid 13.0pp lead over Reform UK. Labour has held a majority since 2011, suggesting strong local support.
St Albans | No overall control | KPM-1 predicts Lib Dems with a narrow 4.0pp lead. With four parties above 10% and no party near 50%, an outright majority for any party is highly improbable.
